decisions.reason: As a recent and relatively weakly signaled launch that is distant from the firm's core range, submarine interior lighting is the easiest product to withdraw because little public commitment has to be defended.
The medical examination light builds on the firm's established lighting capabilities and was given its own product page, so management is likely to continue it and justify the recent investment.

Industrial explosion-proof luminaires fit the firm's industrial customer base and strategic push toward advanced professional lighting, making withdrawal unlikely after visible commitment and development effort.
The designer task light is close to the existing offer and was publicly relaunched as a popular product, so management has clear reasons to persist rather than admit a mistaken renewal.
